resources.string: Import itinerary
One little code. A whole trip.
Got a Journify PDF from a friend? Scan its code to explore and save the trip.
Shared journeys.\nNew inspiration.
Bring a trip back from a Journify PDF QR code. Preview, make it yours, then save.
Scan QR code
Point your camera at a code on another screen or a printed page.
Choose QR image
PDF on this phone? Take a screenshot of the QR page, then choose that image.
Images are decoded on your device, never uploaded. A backend connection is needed to retrieve the trip. Codes last 30 days.
Preview first. Nothing is saved until you tap “Save to my trips”.
